doc.name: Agent Service Directory
doc.description: A directory of APIs, MCP servers and marketplaces for AI agents, with metrics we measure and the prices they state. Send a message saying what you need (for example "send an SMS" or "weather forecast API") and we reply with the services we list for it, with our checks and the prices they state. The same data is at our JSON API (https://agentservicedirectory.com/api/v1/services, described at https://agentservicedirectory.com/openapi.json) and our MCP server (https://agentservicedirectory.com/mcp).

skills.name: Find agent services
skills.description: Finds APIs, MCP servers, A2A agents and task marketplaces for a job, from the words of your message. The reply lists matching services with what each does, its address, the price it states, how to get access and our latest check. A data part may carry our API's search parameters (q, branch, type, access, max_price_usd, passing, min_pass_rate, scope, limit, offset).
